scoring_justification: Headline quantities are computed from given constants; no raw predictions to recompute, so compare reported values to paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values from paper Table 1 for thermodynamic quantities of Te and Zn in GaP
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1: Study of the solubility process of impurities in A3B5 compounds (Semicond. Sci. Technol. 11 912, 1996)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the paper's reported values in Table 1. Verified against solve.sh which writes the same values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published results; the task aims to have the agent reproduce them by implementing the bond-energy/strain method with the given constants.

outputs.description: Computed W_strain, W_A‑I, Q_I, ΔH_I, ΔS_I, and K_I for Te and Zn substitutional impurities in GaP via the bond‑energy/strain method.

output_contract.notes: All inputs are provided as explicit constants; the task does not require downloading external datasets or training models. The output is deterministic given the inputs, and scoring uses tolerance‑based comparison against the paper‑reported values.
